create_basicencoder_feature_extractor: create a BasicEncoder instance to extract 128-dim features from RGB images with batch normalization
create_smallencoder_feature_extractor: create a SmallEncoder instance to extract compact features from RGB images using BottleneckBlock layers
build_residualblock_conv_layer: build a ResidualBlock convolutional layer with configurable group/batch/instance normalization and stride
build_bottleneckblock_conv_layer: build a BottleneckBlock convolutional layer with 1x3x1 bottleneck structure and configurable normalization
run_encoder_forward_pass: run a forward pass through BasicEncoder or SmallEncoder on a tensor or list of image tensors
